description: Starting October 1, Wyoming is on the hook for 75 percent of the cost of running SNAP, up from 50 percent. Washington made that decision. Wyoming taxpayers get the bill.That is not the only change. The federal law behind it also raised the age limit for SNAP work requirements from 54 to 64. Together, these rules make it harder for working Wyomingites to put food on the table and more expensive for our state to run the program.What changedHere is what the new federal rules do: • Work requirements
